name: io.arcaeon/arcaeon
title: Arcaeon
description: A record of what an agent did that the agent cannot quietly rewrite, and a way for anyone to check.

runtimeArguments.name: --with
runtimeArguments.description: The MCP server needs the MCP Python SDK (the package's [mcp] extra); the base install has no dependencies.

packageArguments.description: The verb that starts the MCP server on stdio.

environmentVariables.name: ARCAEON_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Witness API key for the two paid tools (witness_pin, witness_renew). Free tools work without it.
